name: Parser recovery
meaning: A browser can repair malformed source while building its element tree; the repair does not make the source valid.

name: Description list
meaning: A list that pairs names with one or more descriptions.

name: Quotation attribution
meaning: Information that tells readers where a quotation came from.

name: Machine-readable date
meaning: A date written in a specified format so software need not guess the meaning of local wording.

name: Contact semantics
meaning: Markup that identifies who can be contacted about a document or article.

name: Preformatted text
meaning: Text whose spaces and line breaks are intended to be preserved.

name: Figure caption
meaning: A caption belonging to a self-contained figure, often supplying context distinct from image alternative text.

name: Document description
meaning: Short metadata describing a page, without a guarantee about external search presentation.

name: Link context
meaning: The browsing context a link is intended to open, separate from its destination address.

name: Bidirectional isolation
meaning: Keeping one piece of mixed-direction text from unintentionally rearranging surrounding text.

name: Skip link
meaning: A link before repeated content that leads to the main content and supports bypassing the repeated block.

name: Row header
meaning: A th that labels values in its row, commonly identified with scope="row".

name: Explicit table headers
meaning: A headers list identifies the th elements that label a data cell.

name: Required radio group
meaning: Same-name radio inputs permit at most one choice; required adds an at-least-one validation rule.

name: Textarea default text
meaning: Text between textarea tags supplies the initial multiline control value.

name: Step base
meaning: The starting value from which a numeric field’s step increments are measured.

name: Readonly versus disabled
meaning: Readonly supported text controls can submit; disabled controls are excluded from ordinary form data.

name: Repeated form keys
meaning: Multiple participating choices can contribute separate values under the same submitted name.

name: File accept hint
meaning: An advisory file-type selection hint, not proof of received file content.

name: Submitter
meaning: The button initiating a form submission, whose data and overrides can affect that submission.

name: Autofill purpose
meaning: An autocomplete token identifies the kind of user information expected.

name: Whole-value pattern
meaning: A pattern constraint checks the entire nonempty input value.

name: Image aspect-ratio hint
meaning: Width and height provide a proportion before the image is available.

name: Resolution candidate
meaning: A srcset resource with a declared intrinsic width for browser selection.

name: Timed text cue
meaning: A caption text interval bounded by start and end timestamps.

name: Deferred classic script
meaning: An external classic script scheduled after document parsing.

name: Template content fragment
meaning: Inert template markup is held in a separate DocumentFragment.

name: Nonmodal popover
meaning: An overlay that does not make the rest of the page inert.

name: Indeterminate progress
meaning: A progress indicator with no known completion fraction.

name: Source conformance review
meaning: Checking authored source rules separately from the browser’s repaired DOM.
